PRESENT.NAME: THE GROWING ROLE OF THE AMERICAS IN THE GLOBAL ECONOMY
PRESENT.TITLE: The effects of investments to unemployment rate and crime rate: the case of Metropolitan area of McAllen-Edinburg-Mission, Texas
PRESENT.ABSTRACT: The contribution of this research is in the findings of the effect of the investments in the unemployment and crime rate. For this area, the crime rate did not rise at the lowering of the investments. Also unemployment had a non-significant change when investments were low.
